text.tspan: S3 backups unavailable: first find WHICH kind of unavailable
Set up BEFORE: versioning · MFA Delete · Object Lock (compliance mode) · Cross-Region Replication to a separate backup account
· AWS Backup for S3 with vault lock · reviewed lifecycle rules · KMS deletion window 30 days + alarm · alarms on PutBucketPolicy / DeleteBucket
Delete markers are not replicated by default, so a replica survives accidental deletes. After a KMS key is really deleted,
data encrypted with it can never be decrypted. Glacier tiers need restore-object first (minutes to 48 h).
